description: Flat metadata schema for individual freshwater lake water samples collected across depths, locations, and seasons and processed for metagenomic sequencing.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual water sample record.

lake_name.descr: Name of the freshwater lake where the sample was collected.

lake_id.descr: Stable identifier for the lake site, if available (e.g., code used in the study).

sampling_event_id.descr: Identifier linking samples collected at the same time/place/field campaign.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_time.descr: Local time of sample collection, if recorded, in 24-hour format (HH:MM:SS).

season.descr: Season during which the sample was collected; use controlled values such as winter, spring, summer, autumn/fall.

country.descr: Country where the lake is located.

state_province_region.descr: Administrative region, state, or province where the site is located.

site_name.descr: Specific sampling site or station name within the lake.

site_description.descr: Free-text description of the sampling location, shoreline context, station name, or nearby landmark.

coordinate_uncertainty_m.descr: Estimated horizontal uncertainty of the geographic coordinates in meters.

water_depth_m.descr: Total water depth at the sampling location in meters.

sampling_depth_m.descr: Depth from which the water sample was collected in meters below the water surface.

depth_interval_top_m.descr: Upper bound of the sampled depth interval in meters, if depth-integrated or discrete interval sampling was used.

depth_interval_bottom_m.descr: Lower bound of the sampled depth interval in meters, if depth-integrated or discrete interval sampling was used.

depth_zone.descr: General depth zone classification such as surface, epilimnion, metalimnion, hypolimnion, benthic, or discrete_depth.

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature in degrees Celsius.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in milligrams per liter (mg/L).

dissolved_oxygen_percent_sat.descr: Dissolved oxygen saturation in percent, if measured.

ph.descr: In situ pH of the water sample.

conductivity_us_cm.descr: Electrical conductivity in microsiemens per centimeter (µS/cm).

turbidity_ntu.descr: Turbidity in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU), if measured.

secchi_depth_m.descr: Secchi depth in meters, if measured at the site.

nitrate_mg_l.descr: Nitrate concentration in milligrams per liter as reported by the study.

nitrite_mg_l.descr: Nitrite concentration in milligrams per liter as reported by the study.

ammonium_mg_l.descr: Ammonium concentration in milligrams per liter as reported by the study.

phosphate_mg_l.descr: Orthophosphate or phosphate concentration in milligrams per liter as reported by the study.

total_nitrogen_mg_l.descr: Total nitrogen concentration in milligrams per liter, if measured.

total_phosphorus_mg_l.descr: Total phosphorus concentration in milligrams per liter, if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration in micrograms per liter (µg/L), if measured.

dissolved_organic_carbon_mg_l.descr: Dissolved organic carbon concentration in milligrams per liter, if measured.

chloride_mg_l.descr: Chloride concentration in milligrams per liter, if measured.

sample_volume_l.descr: Volume of water processed for nucleic acid extraction in liters.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size in micrometers used for biomass capture, if filtration was used.

filter_material.descr: Filter membrane or cartridge material, e.g., cellulose nitrate, polyethersulfone, glass fiber.

pre_filtration_used.descr: Indicates whether a pre-filtration step was used before primary capture.

preservation_method.descr: Method used to preserve the sample prior to extraction, e.g., flash frozen, liquid nitrogen, RNAlater, filtered and frozen.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature in degrees Celsius before extraction, e.g., -80, -20, 4.

time_to_processing_h.descr: Elapsed time in hours between collection and processing/extraction.

nucleic_acid_target.descr: Primary nucleic acid targeted for extraction, e.g., DNA, RNA, total nucleic acid.

extraction_method.descr: DNA/RNA extraction protocol or kit name used for nucleic acid isolation.

extraction_kit_manufacturer.descr: Manufacturer of the extraction kit, if applicable.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit name used for sequencing library construction.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, MiSeq, NextSeq, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_instrument_model.descr: Specific instrument model used for sequencing, if known.

read_type.descr: Sequencing read configuration, e.g., paired-end, single-end, long-read.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs for short-read sequencing, if applicable.

library_insert_size_bp.descr: Approximate insert size in base pairs, if applicable.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of raw reads generated for the sample.

metagenome_assembled_genomes_generated.descr: Number of metagenome-assembled genomes recovered from this sample, if applicable.

contig_n50_bp.descr: Assembly contig N50 in base pairs, if assembly was performed.

assembly_method.descr: Assembler or assembly workflow used for metagenomic assembly, if applicable.

bio_project_id.descr: Associated project accession or internal project identifier.

bio_sample_id.descr: Associated biosample accession or repository identifier.

replicate_type.descr: Replicate classification such as biological_replicate, technical_replicate, field_duplicate, or none.

replicate_number.descr: Replicate number within the sampling design, if applicable.

sampling_method.descr: Method used to collect water, e.g., Niskin bottle, Van Dorn bottle, grab sample, pump filtration.

sampling_device.descr: Specific device or sampler used, if applicable.

field_notes.descr: Free-text notes about site conditions, weather, ice cover, algal bloom, or other observations.

sample_identifier_in_lab.descr: Internal laboratory sample code used during processing and sequencing.

data_release_status.descr: Status of data availability, e.g., public, embargoed, controlled_access.
